en.s.341: book redemption rate, not your yield
en.s.060: The pool's IMD has crossed the trigger line; the next swap will trim and burn.
en.s.504: Balance locked in the bridge adapter
en.html.doors.lede2: The first door is on Ethereum: once the IMD in the pool passes the line it is pulled out and handed to a waypoint contract. The second door is on Base: someone bridges the IMD out of that waypoint contract and calls burn. Both of the two doors need someone to push them — a person or a bot.

en.s.140: That is a delicate spot: one more IMD and it burns, one fewer and it does not.
en.owner.what.imdSetPeer: Changes the bridge peer: the receiving contract on Base can be pointed at any address, which changes where bridged tokens are burned.
